scope: read-only forensic audit of JEV principles run

decisive_findings.statement: All four admitted revisions retain all visible semantic fields and learned/evidence-only projected inputs are identical.
decisive_findings.implication: Learned-versus-evidence-only scores do not identify a visible semantic-revision effect. Identity revision remains a legitimate outcome; a text delta alone would also be insufficient evidence of improvement.

decisive_findings.statement: Oracle/direct correct-including-refusals is 27 of 48, while direct has 48 valid responses.
decisive_findings.implication: Correct relation text did not make the frozen one-token readout a reliable local executor.

decisive_findings.statement: Direct mode constrains one next token to IDs 15/16 and renormalizes the two reported logprobs.
decisive_findings.implication: It is conditional candidate-token readout, not symbolic execution or a trained binary head.

decisive_findings.statement: Byte-identical paired requests have changed prediction objects under temperature 0 and seed 0; one direct test paired-valid bit differs.
decisive_findings.implication: Single-call arm differences require replicated deterministic-serving validation.

next_gate.name: replicated oracle local semantic execution gate
next_gate.progression_condition: After tokenizer and serving configuration are pinned, a shared-information LLM execution condition completes a near-perfect finite oracle truth-table census and remains stable under predeclared semantic paraphrases and role permutations.
required_ablations: generation with bit-only extraction, separate from probability conformance
typed two-stage LLM execution with intermediate evaluation record
deterministic authored-rule fixture evaluator as task/serialization reference only
next_gate.learning_precondition: A study must classify identity revision as NO_SEMANTIC_DELTA or show a predeclared read-back-visible state/disposition witness that changes the next evaluation frame; semantic text delta alone is neither required nor sufficient.
